description: His answer to the third question is the last: the tutor thanks him, says it can all be changed later, writes it to the index and ends the welcome with welcome_done.

request.question: I get up early and read before anyone else is awake

history.q: Hello, I have just started using Lampas.
history.a: Welcome to Lampas. Why are you here: to read, to study, or to learn the Greek?
Lovely. What would you like Lampas to do for you?
Good. Is there one thing about yourself you would like me to know, so I can help you better?
